evidence.title: What could Meta’s US settlement mean around the world – and what now for other claims against firm?

occurrences.checkable_against: jury proceedings, settlement order and US Congressional records concerning Meta regulation
occurrences.quote_span: A jury has done what the US Congress could not – put controls on a powerful tech company.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: published statement by Arturo Béjar about Meta settlement limitations
occurrences.quote_span: Arturo Béjar, an ex-Facebook employee and whistleblower , said the limitations were “the equivalent of saying: ‘Well, you can smoke as many cigarettes as you can in two hours a day.’ It doesn’t make the cigarettes any safer.”
occurrences.speaker: Arturo Béjar
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: public statement by California attorney general about the Meta settlement
occurrences.quote_span: California’s attorney general said it was a victory that would make “a world of difference for children and their families”.
occurrences.speaker: California attorney general
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: election records and empirical studies of Meta platform effects on the 2024 US presidential election
occurrences.quote_span: It contributed to the election victory of Donald Trump.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: Meta US settlement terms and UK government social-media policy

figure.unit: hours daily use limit for under-18s

occurrences.quote_span: while the UK plans to ban under-16s from social media platforms, it may wish to ask Meta to impose a default daily use limit of two hours for under-18s, which is what the company has agreed to in the US.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: Meta recommendation-system design documents and advertising delivery records
occurrences.quote_span: Meta’s algorithm is intended to keep users scrolling, stuck on the platform, and then it shows them ads.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: investigations, human-rights reports and litigation records concerning Meta's Myanmar content amplification
occurrences.quote_span: It is alleged to have amplified content that promoted the ethnic cleansing of the Rohingya in Myanmar.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: Meta settlement agreement and platform policy implementation records
occurrences.quote_span: As a part of the settlement, Meta has said it will set time limits on children’s use of its platforms Facebook and Instagram and block night-time usage.
occurrences.speaker: Meta
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: court docket and trial transcripts in the 29-state Meta lawsuit
occurrences.quote_span: Its CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, was not forced to testify.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: Meta court filing in the 29-state lawsuit

occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.subject: Meta

occurrences.checkable_against: UK and Australian social-media regulations and Meta platform policies

occurrences.subject: Meta
